lina_cs: Portside Logix (contact: claire@portside) wants to onboard a domain-tuned manifest parser + anonymizer. They require Private (customer VPC), HSM for key ops, strict masking (mask, not delete), and p95 <= 320ms. Need eval plan + renewal impact. Who can own this?
diego_se: I can take SE lead. Quick Qs: model framework/size? realtime or batch?
lina_cs: Claire: PyTorch 2.0, ~5.8B, realtime single-row lookups. They'll provide artifact + ~800 sample rows. NDA addendum required to limit debug logs.
marie_safety: Safety clarifications: what fields are sensitive? Any PHI? Region-specific rules (EU/UK)? We'll need adversarial redaction probes and a tolerance for missed redactions.
lina_cs: Claire: no PHI. Sensitive fields: customer_id, shipment_ref, customs_code, contact_phone. EU customs refs apply. They prefer masking with a fixed token.
diego_se: Ops plan: request schema + traffic profile (QPS, concurrency). Recommend Dedicated small pool nearby for low p95. Will test int8 quant and ephemeral KV cache.
oscar_pm: Product note: ephemeral KV cache only; no persistent token storage. If Dedicated required, this becomes a commercial/reserved capacity conversation — flag renewal risk. Tagging @vicki_sales for pricing.
ticket_bot: onboard-bot: created ticket CS-9987 "portside manifest anonymizer onboarding" https://redwood.atlassian.io/browse/CS-9987 :white_check_mark:
diego_se: Example perf command once we have data:
```
./perf_test --model portside_artifact.pt --data samples.jsonl --qps 20 --concurrency 6 --quantize int8 --ephemeral-kv --out portside_perf.json
```
Use `--ephemeral-kv` both on/off to compare tail. ETA 48-72h after samples.
marie_safety: Eval checklist: 1) redaction adversarial set (500 examples) 2) extraction accuracy for canonical fields 3) prompt-injection stress tests 4) latency profile at 10/20/50 QPS. Deliverables: redaction FNR/FPR, list of high-severity misses, p95/p99. Need data by Thu to keep timeline.
vicki_sales: I'll draft pricing for Dedicated + HSM surcharge and join the QBR. If they require reserved capacity, we'll discuss term length and ramp.
lina_cs: Scheduling tech sync with Claire + infra lead Tue 11am PT. I'll request samples + NDA addendum now and update CS-9987 when they arrive. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
